mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 30 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park under overcast skies. We are looking at a full moon tonight, an overnight low of 29 degrees, and no rain in the forecast.

City tax bills will be mailed by December 15, and residents can pay their property taxes in two installments. You can use the online portal at the city website, mail payments, or use the 24/7 drop boxes located in the City Center parking lot or entrance.

There is plenty to do this week. Today, you can join trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy pizza at Lake Lou-ee, or head to The Bogey Factory for trivia. Also, keep an eye out for the 50th-anniversary craft beer celebration this Thursday at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a recent report, on November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where a woman was found unresponsive in her vehicle; she was later arrested for O W I.
The flavor of the day today is the delicious Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
